// alu test vectors
// format: a(hex) b(hex) ALUControl(dec) result(hex) zero(bin) cout(bin) overflow(bin)
// ALUControl: 0 AND, 1 OR, 2 ADD, 6 SUB, 7 SLT, 8 XOR, 9 SLL, 10 SRL, 11 SRA, 12 SLTU,
//             16 MUL, 17 MULH, 18 MULHSU, 19 MULHU, 20 DIV, 21 DIVU, 22 REM, 23 REMU
// cout/overflow come straight from the adder (a - b for SUB, SLT, SLTU; a + b otherwise).
// Divider operations: the testbench pulses div_start, waits for div_done, checks, then pulses div_ack.
//
// reference cases
